name: io.github.olo-dot-io/Uni-CLI
description: Open Agent-Computer Interface runtime for real software, with a static catalog of 324 adapter sites, 993 declarative YAML adapters, and 1817 registered adapter commands. Native CLI also loads fixed core and host-discovered commands; MCP default, deferred, and expanded profiles project adapter commands. Structured errors can name the owning adapter, and bounded repair verification reruns the exact original command without hidden mutation.
